title: MixerCSeg: An Efficient Mixer Architecture for Crack Segmentation via Decoupled Mamba Attention
mechanism: A mixer encoder with CNN, Transformer and Mamba-like paths, a direction-guided edge gated convolution (DEGConv) and spatial refinement multi-level fusion (2.54M params).
adaptation: Run it as a benchmark baseline with a 24-class head at 512 px. Separately, lift DEGConv into the house decoder as a crack-edge module.
min_experiment: Benchmark row vs house, 3 seeds, full protocol. DEGConv-in-house arm: kill if crack relF1@2 gains < 0.012.
evidence: R: state of the art on several crack benchmarks at 2.05 GFLOPs (abstract). WebSearch shows it on the CVPR 2026 open-access site.

alt_notes.adaptation: Benchmark entry as a 2026 crack SOTA; same adaptation as SCSegamba (1-channel stem, 512 px, 3-class and 24-class variants).
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: MixerCSeg official recipe; baseline PF; 3 seeds. Metric: CV crack IoU, relF1@2. Kill as a model if CV crack IoU < PF minus 0.02; keep as benchmark row.
